quarterly_data.quarter: ASUS press release: ASUS ProArt RTX Spark Windows PCs Available for Immediate (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ASUS launched globally the ProArt P16 and P14 laptops and the ProArt GR1X mini PC, all powered by NVIDIA RTX Spark (NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU, NVIDIA Grace CPU, NVLink-C2C; up to 1 petaflop of AI performance and up to 128GB of unified memory). Global pre-orders for the P16 and P14 began on October 7, 2026, with the first units arriving in the U.S. on October 16, 2026; 24GB, 32GB, 36GB and 48GB configurations at the ASUS eShop and Best Buy, 64GB and 128GB mainly through the ASUS eShop and Best Buy (128GB also at Micro Center); ProArt laptops start at US$2,599.99 (MSRP) at Best Buy. The ProArt GR1X will be available later this year, mainly in 64GB and 128GB configurations. ASUS names partnerships with ComfyUI and Nous Research's Hermes Agent for local AI workflows.
quarterly_data.figure: pre-orders October 7, 2026; first U.S. units October 16, 2026; from US$2,599.99
